svg.title: Klieg's herdr-style window
svg.desc: Klieg's window: spaces and agents on the left, tabs on top, and the selected agent's live Claude Code session in a lavender frame. dev-review stops to ask for approval: its dot turns pink, it moves to the top of the agents list, the tab switches to it, it's answered from Klieg, and the builder pushes PR #3.
